tha-ap290:1.1: Sattāhapabbajita.] Vipassissa bhagavato saṅgho sakkatamānito / vyasanaṃ me anuppattaṃ ñātibhedo pure ahu. // //
tha-ap290:2.1: Pabbajjam upagantvāna vyasanūpasamāy' ahaṃ / sattāhābhirato tattha satthusāsanakamyatā. // //
tha-ap290:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yam ahaṃ pabbajiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pabbajjāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap290:4.1: Sattasaṭṭhi ito kappe satta āsuṃ mahīpatī / Sunikkhammā ti ñāyanti cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap290:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sattāhapabbajito thero i. g. a-ti.
